categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: paper manufacturing (industrial paper and newsprint), specialty paper, and real estate development. It produces kraft paper and newsprint through its facilities in Gunsan and Cheongju, and engages in real estate development projects mainly in Gunsan. The company also has subsidiaries involved in media and real estate sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses paper resources as main raw materials, employing capital-intensive manufacturing processes with large-scale facilities for kraft paper and newsprint production. Production capacity is calculated based on maximum machine output and operating hours, with high utilization rates (~97-98%). The company also focuses on process innovation and quality improvement through a dedicated process innovation team. Media-related subsidiaries develop high-resolution, eco-friendly printing materials and electronic display protective films.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic newspaper companies such as Chosun Ilbo, Dong-A Ilbo, and Maeil Business Newspaper for newsprint, as well as printing companies and industrial users for kraft and specialty papers. The company exports to Southeast Asian countries including China, Taiwan, and Vietnam. Media products are sold globally to over 50 companies, including NESCHEN and PAPER UNION. Real estate development targets residential apartment buyers in Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Gunsan and Cheongju, and a branch office in Seoul. It exports paper products to Southeast Asia (China, Taiwan, Vietnam) and media products to Europe, the Americas, and Asia. Real estate development projects are concentrated in Gunsan, Jeollabuk-do, South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the paper supply chain, manufacturing industrial and newsprint paper from raw paper resources. It sources raw materials domestically and internationally and sells finished paper products to end users and distributors. The real estate segment operates downstream, developing and selling residential properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening production technology and process innovation to improve product quality and efficiency. R&D efforts focus on developing new products, eco-friendly materials, and high-resolution printing media. The company emphasizes innovation in printing substrates and electronic display protective films through its media subsidiaries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of industrial paper, newsprint, specialty paper, and real estate property sales. The company sells products domestically and internationally via direct sales, agents, and distributors. Real estate revenue comes from apartment sales and land development. Media subsidiaries generate revenue from sales of printing materials and coatings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic kraft paper market, the company holds the number one market share, competing with two other major manufacturers (Kukil Paper, Songhak Paper). The newsprint market is oligopolistic with three main producers, making new entrants unlikely. The media segment faces intense competition, especially from Chinese products, but maintains competitiveness in PET products. The real estate segment operates in a regulated and cyclical market influenced by government policies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized enterprise with total assets around 491.7 billion KRW and equity of approximately 295.2 billion KRW as of 2023. Revenue for 2023 was about 362 billion KRW, down 11.7% from the previous year, but operating profit increased by 20.6%, reflecting improved profitability. The company has significantly reduced its debt ratio from 714% to 67% over one year, indicating a strengthened financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality industrial and newsprint paper production with a focus on eco-friendly materials and process efficiency. It leverages its leading market position and production capacity to ensure timely supply and competitive pricing. Its media products focus on innovative, high-resolution, and environmentally friendly printing substrates. Real estate development benefits from strategic land assets and integrated project execution through subsidiaries.
